desc: Implement the complete baseline solution: compute every length-x window cost as the sum of absolute deviations from the window median using a two-heap sliding median with lazy deletion, then run the O(k*n) DP for choosing exactly k non-overlapping windows; include the starter class and return the minimum operations.

Validate the solution against the two provided examples and a randomized brute force for small n, x, and k, comparing against exhaustive selection of non-overlapping windows and direct median-cost computation.
